_comment: Expected enabled/disabled state of every GitHub Actions workflow.
A workflow's disabled state lives in GitHub, NOT in the repo — `gh workflow disable` leaves no
trace in git. So every gate in this repo passed while ten scheduled lanes, including the only
monitor, were switched off and the YAML schedules were fiction. This file is the missing half:
scripts/check_workflow_state.py diffs it against the live API, so a freeze or a thaw has to be
To change a workflow's state: run `gh workflow enable|disable <file>` AND update this file in

acquire-audit.yml.reason: Thawed 2026-08-04. The 2026-08-01 freeze was never a cost necessity: the overage was backfill campaigns (36.9M of July's 68.1M rows on three days), not these lanes. The three lanes that DID carry avoidable cost - EVDS, weekly, TEFAS - re-stamped unchanged rows and re-shipped them to D1; all three now compare before writing (see OPERATIONS.md, D1 write budget), taking the quiet baseline to roughly 7M/month against 50M included.

analyst-daily.yml.reason: Active but UNSCHEDULED — dispatch-only under the 2026-08-01 D1-write freeze. Produces signals+memos as run artifacts; contains NO D1 push step at all. The daily 07:00 UTC cron and the push steps go in when the freeze lifts (see the workflow header).
